The '''T-65C-A2 X-wing starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a variant of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. Both this model and the [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B]] were the primary X-wings of the Rebellion.<ref name="SWDB">{{DB|starship|xwing|X-wing starfighter}}</ref><ref name="SWSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref><ref name="RASB">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> However, the C-A2 model was rare due to the T-65's difficult construction. New X-wings were always a rare sight during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWSB" /> It was seen in use before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TFP" /><ref name="css" />
